title: Seedance 2.5 vs Wan 3.0:
hook: Two new AI video models got the exact same tiny-explorer scene. Can you tell them apart?
caption:
Two new AI video models got the exact same prompt. Can you tell them apart? 👀

Same tiny explorer, same giant kitchen, two different AI video generators.

ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 and Alibaba's Wan 3.0 can both now make 30-second clips with native audio, and the gap between "real" and AI is shrinking fast.

Which half looks more real to you? Tell us in the comments 👇
